title: Tofu and veg stir-fry with rice
steps: Start the rice if it isn't cooked yet: brown rice takes 25 to 30 minutes (follow the pack). Leftover rice is fine; reheat it until steaming hot.
Drain the tofu, press it dry between paper towels and cut it into cubes. Cut the broccoli into small florets and slice the pepper and carrot thinly.
Heat the oil in a wok or large pan over medium-high heat and fry the tofu for 6 to 8 minutes until golden, then lift it out.
Stir-fry the vegetables for 4 to 5 minutes with crushed garlic and grated ginger.
Return the tofu with a splash of soy sauce, toss for a minute and serve on the rice.
